product.ta-1100.summary: The TA 1100 adapted storage to each office through external units.
product.ta-1100.history: Triumph-Adler designed it for office administration. In 1980, seven branches of the air cargo company J. H. Bachmann used the TA 1100 with floppy drives.
product.ta-1100.technical.configuration: Magnetic media held programs and data. The manual describes up to three separate cassette units. The FDE unit could accommodate up to four floppy drives.
product.ta-1100.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-1100.technical.limitations: Firmware and system media from an identified installation remain to be recovered.
product.ta-1100.technical.source_3: Schneller durch die Luft verfrachtet · Computerwoche, 1980
